 Bears Discussion: Patriots recap, 2027 NFL Draft TE prospects, DFS, and more
 Tune in to the latest edition of Bears for Breakfast as the guys recap Bears-Patriots!
 by Jacob Infante Oct 24, 2026, 2:00 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Chicago Bears improved to 5-2 on Thursday night, picking up a key win over the New England on primetime television. It was a battle of two hot teams with two top head coaches and two ascending, young quarterbacks, but in the end, it was Ben Johnson and Caleb Williams who came out victorious.
 What’s next for the Bears after their second win in a row? How high is the ceiling for this team the way that it’s currently constructed? Jacob Infante and Jacob White talk about it all in the latest edition of Bears for Breakfast.
 Plus, the guys share their thoughts on the upcoming NFL trade deadline, 2027 NFL Draft tight end prospects, Week 7 DFS cash lineups, and more!
 The video version will be live at 10 a.m. CT, so stop by to ask some questions and interact with the show! 
 Our 2nd City Gridiron Podcast Channel is available on Apple , Spotify , iHeart , Audacy , and other popular podcast platforms, so hit subscribe wherever you get your audio. Our YouTube home is also called 2nd City Gridiron , so subscribe there for our pods and other video content.
